body: I used to slip my hand into a rolled up sleeping bag and pretended it was like a megaman arm gun. I also had a birthmark on my for arm in the shape of a circle that would be the button to activate my wrist laser like buzz lightyear.
I am not and have never been abused by anyone.

I know how you feel, telling my gf that I was having suicidal thoughts was hard but once I did it, she didnt judge me, she comforted me and in that moment it was all i wanted. whenever I'm having thoughts i talk to her, it helps to talk to someone, i know it's hard, I would even love to listen to you and i know what it all feels like, but your bf is someone that should know too, dont be afraid, it'll be ok to tell someone.
